schema:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "AdminUser" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    "email" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Admin',
    "passwordHash" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OWNER',
    "createdAt" DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    "updatedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "AdminSession" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    "token" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "userId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "expiresAt" DATETIME NOT NULL,
    "createdAt" DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    CONSTRAINT "AdminSession_userId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "AdminUser" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Category" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "shortDescription" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "longDescription" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "imageUrl" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "imageAlt" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "introContent" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "bottomContent" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "featured" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    "displayOrder" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    "parentId" TEXT,
    "published" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    "seoTitle" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "metaDescription" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "focusKeyword" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "secondaryKeywords" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "ogTitle" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "ogDescription" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "canonicalUrl" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "createdAt" DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    "updatedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "Category_parentId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("parentId") REFERENCES "Category" ("id") ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Product" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "sku" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "categoryId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "subcategory" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "shortDescription" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "longDescription" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "highlights" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "customizationOptions" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "size" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "material" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "colour" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "occasion" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "careInstructions" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "tags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "featured" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    "published" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    "displayOrder" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    "relatedProductIds" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    "seoTitle" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "metaDescription" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "focusKeyword" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "secondaryKeywords" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "ogTitle" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "ogDescription" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "canonicalUrl" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "createdAt" DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    "updatedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "Product_categoryId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("categoryId") REFERENCES "Category" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ProductImage" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    "productId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "url" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "alt" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "caption" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "isFeatured" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    "displayOrder" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    CONSTRAINT "ProductImage_productId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("productId") REFERENCES "Product" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "BlogCategory" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "displayOrder" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "BlogPost" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    "title" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "excerpt" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "content" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "coverImage" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "coverAlt" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "author" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Khushi',
    "readingTime" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4,
    "tags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "featured" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
    "publishAt" DATETIME,
    "publishedAt" DATETIME,
    "blogCategoryId" TEXT,
    "relatedProductSlugs" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    "seoTitle" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "metaDescription" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "focusKeyword" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "secondaryKeywords" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "ogTitle" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "ogDescription" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "canonicalUrl" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "createdAt" DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    "updatedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "BlogPost_blogCategoryId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("blogCategoryId") REFERENCES "BlogCategory" ("id") ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Page" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    "title" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "content" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "published" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    "displayOrder" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    "seoTitle" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "metaDescription" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "createdAt" DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    "updatedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Faq" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    "question" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "answer" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "entityType" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GENERAL',
    "entityId" TEXT,
    "displayOrder" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    "published" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    "createdAt" DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    "updatedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL,
    "productId" TEXT,
    "blogPostId" TEXT,
    "pageId" TEXT,
    CONSTRAINT "Faq_productId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("productId") REFERENCES "Product" ("id") ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT "Faq_blogPostId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("blogPostId") REFERENCES "BlogPost" ("id") ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT "Faq_pageId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("pageId") REFERENCES "Page" ("id") ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Lead" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "mobile" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "city" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "product" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "productUrl" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "category" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "message" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "preferredContact" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "sourcePage" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "utmSource" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "utmMedium" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "utmCampaign" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "referrer" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NEW',
    "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "sheetSynced" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    "createdAt" DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    "updatedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "MediaAsset" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    "url" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "filename" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "alt" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "caption" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "size" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    "createdAt" DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "SiteSetting" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    "key" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "value" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "HomepageSection" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    "sectionKey" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "heading" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "subheading" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "body" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "imageUrl" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "ctaText" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "ctaUrl" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "ctaText2" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "ctaUrl2" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "itemsJson" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    "visible" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    "displayOrder" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    "updatedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "MediaBlob" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    "filename" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "chunkIndex" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "data" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "createdAt" DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "AdminUser_email_key" ON "AdminUser"("email");

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "AdminSession_token_key" ON "AdminSession"("token");

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "Category_slug_key" ON "Category"("slug");

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "Product_slug_key" ON "Product"("slug");

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "BlogCategory_slug_key" ON "BlogCategory"("slug");

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "BlogPost_slug_key" ON "BlogPost"("slug");

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "Page_slug_key" ON "Page"("slug");

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "SiteSetting_key_key" ON "SiteSetting"("key");

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "HomepageSection_sectionKey_key" ON "HomepageSection"("sectionKey");

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "MediaBlob_filename_chunkIndex_key" ON "MediaBlob"("filename", "chunkIndex");

Category.name: Resin Nameplates
Category.shortDescription: Personalized nameplates for homes & offices — handcrafted with premium resin, gold lettering and preserved florals.
Category.longDescription: Bespoke resin nameplates designed around your family name, home palette and style. Choose from wooden-backed classic designs, modern minimal blocks or floral-embedded statement pieces.
Category.imageAlt: Resin Nameplates handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi
Category.introContent:
A nameplate is the first hello your home gives. Our handcrafted resin nameplates turn that hello into art — your family name in elegant golden lettering, floated in crystal-clear premium resin alongside real dried flowers, terracotta swirls or gold flakes.

Every nameplate is custom-made: your text, your fonts, your colour palette, your size. Whether it's a warm wooden-backed classic for your entrance, a sleek block for your office desk, or a couple nameplate for a wedding gift — we craft it to fit beautifully.
Category.bottomContent: How to order your resin nameplate: share the text, preferred colours and size, and we'll send you a design preview before pouring begins. Most nameplates ship within 7–10 days. Enquire on WhatsApp for a quick quote.
Category.metaDescription: Personalized nameplates for homes & offices — handcrafted with premium resin, gold lettering and preserved florals. Handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi — personalized, premium and made to order. Enquire now.

Category.name: Spiritual & Mantra Frames
Category.shortDescription: Devotional resin frames — mantras, Om, Ek Onkar and mandala art for a positive, calm space.
Category.longDescription: Spiritual resin art frames with golden mantras, Om symbols, mandalas and personalized devotional designs — bringing positivity and calm to your home, pooja room or office.
Category.imageAlt: Spiritual & Mantra Frames handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi
Category.introContent:
Bring serenity into your space with our spiritual resin collection — golden mantras, Om symbols and mandala patterns floated in warm amber resin. Each frame is crafted to be both a devotional centrepiece and a piece of art you're proud to display.

Popular as housewarming and Diwali gifts, these frames can be personalized with your chosen mantra, family deity motif or a Sanskrit shloka close to your heart.
Category.bottomContent: Spiritual frames make meaningful housewarming, Griha Pravesh and festive gifts. Ask us about matching sets for your pooja room or a personalized mantra of your choice.
Category.metaDescription: Devotional resin frames — mantras, Om, Ek Onkar and mandala art for a positive, calm space. Handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi — personalized, premium and made to order. Enquire now.

Category.name: Lippan / Mud Mirror Art
Category.shortDescription: Traditional Gujarati Lippan mirror art — hand sculpted clay relief with mirrors, made modern.
Category.longDescription: Handcrafted Lippan art panels in the traditional Kutch style — sculpted clay relief patterns with mirrors, offered in classic white, terracotta and modern color palettes.
Category.imageAlt: Lippan / Mud Mirror Art handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi
Category.introContent:
Lippan art — the beautiful mud-and-mirror craft of Kutch, Gujarat — has decorated Indian homes for generations. Our panels honour the tradition with hand-sculpted clay relief and mirrors, refreshed in palettes that suit modern interiors.

From classic white-and-mirror motifs to peacock centre-pieces with terracotta borders, each panel is sculpted entirely by hand. Custom motifs, sizes and colours are welcome.
Category.bottomContent: Lippan panels are striking statement pieces for living rooms, entryways and pooja spaces. Custom family motifs, auspicious symbols and matching sets can be made to order.
Category.metaDescription: Traditional Gujarati Lippan mirror art — hand sculpted clay relief with mirrors, made modern. Handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi — personalized, premium and made to order. Enquire now.

Category.name: Resin Wall Art
Category.shortDescription: Abstract & geode-style resin wall art — fluid gold, terracotta and crystal statement panels.
Category.longDescription: One-of-a-kind resin wall art — fluid abstract pours, geode panels with crystals and gold veins, made to your palette and size.
Category.imageAlt: Resin Wall Art handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi
Category.introContent:
Statement walls deserve statement art. Our resin wall panels are poured in fluid waves of gold, champagne, terracotta and blush — or sculpted into geode masterpieces with real crystal points and gold veining.

Because resin art is poured by hand, no two panels can ever be identical — your wall art is genuinely one-of-a-kind. Share your room's palette and dimensions and we'll design a piece made for that exact wall.
Category.bottomContent: Wall art is available from compact 12-inch accents to large 4-foot centre-pieces. Custom colour matching to your interiors is our speciality — just share a photo of your wall.
Category.metaDescription: Abstract & geode-style resin wall art — fluid gold, terracotta and crystal statement panels. Handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi — personalized, premium and made to order. Enquire now.

Category.name: Resin Trays
Category.shortDescription: Serving trays & lazy susans in marble, mandala and terrazzo resin — with brass handles.
Category.longDescription: Handcrafted resin serving trays, vanity trays and lazy susans — marble swirls, mandala art and gold-rimmed finishes with optional brass handles.
Category.imageAlt: Resin Trays handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi
Category.introContent:
Serve in style. Our resin trays combine art with utility — ivory marble swirls, terracotta mandalas or terrazzo chips, finished with gold rims and optional brass handles. Perfect for chai sessions, festive hosting, vanity organisation and gifting.

Choose from round, oval and rectangular shapes in multiple sizes. Matching coaster sets can be crafted to complete the set.
Category.bottomContent: Trays pair beautifully with our coasters and nameplates for coordinated gifting. Festive and wedding-season hampers are available — enquire early for bulk dates.
Category.metaDescription: Serving trays & lazy susans in marble, mandala and terrazzo resin — with brass handles. Handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi — personalized, premium and made to order. Enquire now.

Category.name: Resin Coasters
Category.shortDescription: Hexagonal, square & terrazzo coaster sets with real pressed flowers and gold edges.
Category.longDescription: Handcrafted resin coaster sets — hexagonal florals, terrazzo monograms and gold-edge finishes in gift-ready packaging.
Category.imageAlt: Resin Coasters handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi
Category.introContent:
Coasters are the smallest canvas with the biggest charm. Our sets feature real pressed flowers, gold edges, terrazzo chips and monogram letters — each coaster sealed in glossy, heat-safe premium resin.

Sets come in hexagonal, square and round shapes with matching holders. Add a monogram or family name to make them truly yours — or gift-ready boxes for weddings and festive giving.
Category.bottomContent: Coaster sets are our most gifted item — perfect for housewarmings, birthdays and corporate gifting. Bulk and custom-monogram orders welcome.
Category.metaDescription: Hexagonal, square & terrazzo coaster sets with real pressed flowers and gold edges. Handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi — personalized, premium and made to order. Enquire now.

Category.name: Resin Keychains
Category.shortDescription: Personalized keychains with initials, name waves, dried flowers & glitter — sweet little gifts.
Category.longDescription: Custom resin keychains — initials, name waves, hearts, roses and matching couple sets in gold and colour palettes of your choice.
Category.imageAlt: Resin Keychains handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi
Category.introContent:
Small tokens, big smiles. Our resin keychains carry initials, name waves, preserved petals and gold glitter — on sturdy rings that survive daily use. Matching couple sets and bulk return-gift orders are a studio favourite.

Pick your shape, colours and text; we'll craft singles, pairs or party batches. Popular for return gifts, proposals and friendship day.
Category.bottomContent: Bulk orders (10+ pieces) get a special rate and coordinated packaging. Share your event date and theme for a matching set.
Category.metaDescription: Personalized keychains with initials, name waves, dried flowers & glitter — sweet little gifts. Handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi — personalized, premium and made to order. Enquire now.

Category.name: Resin Jewellery
Category.shortDescription: Statement earrings, pendants & bangles — wearable resin art with florals and gold leaf.
Category.longDescription: Handcrafted resin jewellery — statement earrings, dainty studs, pendants and bangles with pressed flowers, gold leaf and ink swirls.
Category.imageAlt: Resin Jewellery handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi
Category.introContent:
Wearable art, feather-light on the ears. Our resin jewellery line carries pressed flowers, gold leaf and swirling inks in glossy settings — from statement terracotta earrings to dainty floral studs and teardrop pendants.

Each piece is finished with hypoallergenic gold-plated hooks and chains. Custom colour matching to your outfit is available — share a photo of your ensemble.
Category.bottomContent: Bridal and festive jewellery sets can be crafted to match your outfit palette. Enquire early with your date so we can cure and finish perfectly.
Category.metaDescription: Statement earrings, pendants & bangles — wearable resin art with florals and gold leaf. Handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi — personalized, premium and made to order. Enquire now.

Category.name: Memory Preservation
Category.shortDescription: Wedding bouquets & milestone keepsakes preserved forever in crystal-clear resin.
Category.longDescription: Memory preservation art — your real wedding bouquet, anniversary roses and baby keepsakes encased forever in museum-grade clear resin.
Category.imageAlt: Memory Preservation handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi
Category.introContent:
Some moments deserve more than a photograph. Our memory preservation pieces carefully encase your real flowers and keepsakes — a wedding bouquet, proposal roses, first birthday cap and shoes, a loved one's cherished item — in crystal-clear resin that never yellows.

Send us your preserved flowers (or we'll guide you through pressing them), and we'll design a heart, frame or block that keeps that day within reach, forever.
Category.bottomContent: Memory orders need extra care: flowers must be fully dried (we guide you), and curing takes longer. Reserve your slot 3–4 weeks before your occasion where possible.
Category.metaDescription: Wedding bouquets & milestone keepsakes preserved forever in crystal-clear resin. Handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi — personalized, premium and made to order. Enquire now.

Category.name: Custom Orders
Category.shortDescription: Anything you dream — custom size, colour, theme, name and design, handcrafted to brief.
Category.longDescription: Fully custom resin commissions — share your idea, size, palette and theme and we'll design and handcraft it to brief.
Category.imageAlt: Custom Orders handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi
Category.introContent:
If you can imagine it, we can probably pour it. Custom orders are where our studio is happiest — corporate logos, pet portraits in resin, matching wedding favour sets, anniversary countdown gifts, or a one-of-one piece nobody else will ever own.

Share your brief with sizes, colours, themes and photos of the space or person it's for. We'll respond with a design plan, timeline and honest advice on what will look best.
Category.bottomContent: Custom commissions begin with a quick chat on WhatsApp. We take a limited number of custom slots each month to keep quality high — book early.
Category.metaDescription: Anything you dream — custom size, colour, theme, name and design, handcrafted to brief. Handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi — personalized, premium and made to order. Enquire now.

Product.name: Personalized Family Resin Nameplate
Product.shortDescription: Your family name in golden lettering, floated in crystal-clear resin with real dried flowers and gold flakes — mounted on rich wooden backing.
Product.longDescription:
The signature Artistic by Khushi nameplate. Your family name is rendered in elegant golden lettering, then floated in crystal-clear, UV-stabilised resin alongside real dried flowers, terracotta swirls and delicate gold flakes. The rich espresso-toned resin base gives a premium depth that printed nameplates simply can't match.

Every plate is made to order — your text, your font style, your palette. Holes are pre-drilled for easy mounting, and each piece arrives carefully packaged with hanging hardware and a care card.
Product.highlights:
Custom family name, house number or mantra in golden lettering
Real preserved dried flowers & premium gold flakes
Rich espresso resin base with clear glossy top layer
Weather-resistant UV-stabilised finish
Pre-fitted with hanging hooks — mounts in minutes
Product.customizationOptions:
Family name / text of your choice
Font style & letter finish (gold / copper / silver)
Base colour palette
Floral or geometric inlay theme
Custom size for your entrance
Product.material: Premium epoxy resin, real dried florals, wooden backing
Product.colour: Espresso brown with gold & clear top
Product.careInstructions: Wipe with a soft dry cloth. Avoid direct harsh sunlight and abrasive cleaners.
Product.tags: nameplate, housewarming gift, personalized, resin nameplate, home entrance
Product.metaDescription: Your family name in golden lettering, floated in crystal-clear resin with real dried flowers and gold flakes — mounted on rich wooden backing. Handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi. Enquire on WhatsApp for personalization & pricing.

Product.name: Couple Name Resin Nameplate
Product.shortDescription: Two names, one heart — blush pink and cream resin waves with golden couple names, made for wedding gifts.
Product.longDescription:
Made for weddings, anniversaries and new beginnings. Two names flow together over blush-pink and cream resin waves, joined by a delicate golden heart. The soft palette photographs beautifully and suits modern, minimal interiors.

Add a wedding date beneath the names for a keepsake the couple will keep forever. Gift-wrapping available.
Product.highlights:
Two custom names with optional wedding date
Blush pink & cream wave palette
Golden heart accent and lettering
Wedding-gift ready packaging
Product.customizationOptions:
Both names & date
Palette (blush / ivory / sage / terracotta)
Heart or infinity accent
Size & orientation
Product.material: Premium epoxy resin, gold foil accents
Product.careInstructions: Dust with a soft cloth; keep away from prolonged direct sunlight.
Product.tags: couple nameplate, wedding gift, anniversary, resin art
Product.metaDescription: Two names, one heart — blush pink and cream resin waves with golden couple names, made for wedding gifts. Handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi. Enquire on WhatsApp for personalization & pricing.

Product.name: Executive Office Nameplate
Product.shortDescription: Sleek desk-block nameplate in matte charcoal and gold — for desks, clinics and receptions.
Product.longDescription: A quiet statement for professional spaces. This freestanding desk block pairs matte charcoal resin with brass-style lettering — your name, designation or clinic name in a clean modern layout. Weighted base keeps it steady on desks and reception counters.
Product.highlights:
Freestanding weighted desk block
Matte charcoal with brass-style lettering
Name, designation or clinic branding
Lacquered smudge-resistant finish
Product.customizationOptions:
Text lines (name / designation)
Letter finish
Logo inlay for clinics & offices
Block size
Product.careInstructions: Wipe gently with a dry microfibre cloth.
Product.tags: office nameplate, desk nameplate, professional gift
Product.metaDescription: Sleek desk-block nameplate in matte charcoal and gold — for desks, clinics and receptions. Handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi. Enquire on WhatsApp for personalization & pricing.

Product.name: Gayatri Mantra Resin Frame
Product.shortDescription: The Gayatri Mantra in flowing gold calligraphy on ivory resin, framed with a subtle mandala border.
Product.longDescription: The Gayatri Mantra carries light, and so does this frame. Rendered in flowing gold calligraphy on warm ivory resin, it is bordered by a subtle mandala pattern that catches the eye without overwhelming a calm space. Ideal for pooja rooms, entrances and meditation corners.
Product.highlights:
Complete Gayatri Mantra in gold calligraphy
Ivory resin with mandala border
Ready-to-hang gallery frame
Housewarming & Diwali favourite
Product.customizationOptions:
Mantra or shloka of your choice
Frame size & colour
Add family name or deity motif
Product.material: Epoxy resin art panel, wooden frame
Product.careInstructions: Soft dry cloth only; avoid hanging in direct harsh sunlight.
Product.tags: gayatri mantra, spiritual frame, pooja room decor, diwali gift
Product.metaDescription: The Gayatri Mantra in flowing gold calligraphy on ivory resin, framed with a subtle mandala border. Handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi. Enquire on WhatsApp for personalization & pricing.

Product.name: Ek Onkar Resin Wall Frame
Product.shortDescription: The Ik Onkar symbol in luminous golden resin over a cream-amber marbled background — a serene spiritual gift.
Product.longDescription: Ik Onkar, rendered in luminous gold over cream and amber marbled resin — a serene piece for Sikh households and a deeply meaningful gift for Gurpurab, weddings and housewarmings. Each background is hand-marbled, so every frame is unique.
Product.highlights:
Ik Onkar in golden resin relief
Hand-marbled cream-amber background
Ready to hang or gift
Meaningful Gurpurab & wedding gift
Product.customizationOptions:
Background palette
Frame size
Add family name beneath
Product.careInstructions: Dust with dry cloth.
Product.tags: ek onkar, ik onkar, sikh gift, spiritual wall art
Product.metaDescription: The Ik Onkar symbol in luminous golden resin over a cream-amber marbled background — a serene spiritual gift. Handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi. Enquire on WhatsApp for personalization & pricing.

Product.name: Peacock Lippan Mirror Art Panel
Product.shortDescription: A majestic peacock motif in hand-sculpted clay relief with mirrors — traditional Kutch Lippan art with a terracotta border.
Product.longDescription:
Our most loved Lippan panel: a majestic peacock rendered in traditional hand-sculpted clay relief, its feathers dotted with mirrors that glitter as light moves across the room. The terracotta border grounds the piece in Kutchi craft tradition while suiting contemporary walls.

Sculpted entirely by hand — no moulds — in a process that takes several patient days.
Product.highlights:
Hand-sculpted clay relief (no moulds)
Mirror-inlaid peacock motif
Terracotta & cream palette
Statement size for living rooms & entryways
Product.customizationOptions:
Motif (peacock / floral / elephant / custom)
Palette
Panel size
Product.material: Natural clay relief, mirrors, resin-sealed finish
Product.careInstructions: Dust gently; mirrors can be wiped with a soft damp cloth.
Product.tags: lippan art, mud mirror art, kutch craft, wall panel
Product.metaDescription: A majestic peacock motif in hand-sculpted clay relief with mirrors — traditional Kutch Lippan art with a terracotta border. Handcrafted by Artistic by Khushi. Enquire on WhatsApp for personalization & pricing.

Product.name: Golden Tides Abstract Resin Wall Art
Product.shortDescription: Champagne-gold and terracotta waves poured in fluid resin — a one-of-one statement panel for your living room.
Product.longDescription:
Golden Tides pours champagne gold and terracotta in layered waves over a crisp white base — fluid art that no one else will ever own, because each pour is unrepeatable. A statement piece sized for sofas, consoles and headboards.

Share your room palette and we'll tune the wave colours to your interior before pouring.
Product.highlights:
One-of-one — unrepeatable fluid pour
Champagne gold, terracotta & blush palette
Gallery-depth glossy finish
Custom palettes to match your room
Product.customizationOptions:
Colour palette
Size & orientation
Horizontal or wave direction
Product.careInstructions: Dust with a soft dry cloth; avoid direct harsh sunlight.
Product.tags: resin wall art, abstract art, fluid art, living room decor

BlogPost.title: How to Care for Resin Art: Keep It Glossy for Years
BlogPost.excerpt: Simple habits that keep your resin nameplates, coasters and jewellery looking freshly-poured for years — no fancy products needed.
BlogPost.content:
Why resin art stays glossy — the science in one line

Cured epoxy resin is chemically stable and water-resistant. What ages it is UV exposure, abrasion and heat. Manage those three, and your pieces stay showroom-fresh.

Five care rules that matter

  1. Soft cloth only. Microfibre or cotton — never scrubbers.
  2. Keep out of harsh direct sun. Our resin is UV-stabilised, but years of intense daily sun can dull any polymer.
  3. Coasters: wipe, don't soak. A damp cloth handles rings instantly.
  4. No hot pans on resin. Trays are for serving; direct pan-contact heats local spots.
  5. Jewellery: last on, first off. Perfume and resin are fine together for seconds, not hours.

Quick gloss refresh

If a piece ever looks tired after years, a tiny drop of carnauba wax on a soft cloth brings back the mirror finish in thirty seconds.

When in doubt

Every Artistic by Khushi order ships with a care card — and you can always message us on WhatsApp with a photo; we're happy to advise.

BlogPost.title: Memory Preservation: How Your Wedding Bouquet Becomes Forever
BlogPost.excerpt: The step-by-step journey from your wedding day flowers to a crystal-clear resin keepsake — drying, design, casting and delivery.
BlogPost.content:
Why preserve flowers at all?

Photographs show the bouquet; a preserved piece is the bouquet. Brides tell us holding the actual petals from their wedding day hits differently — a small, heavy, permanent piece of the morning they said yes.

The journey, step by step

1. You press (we guide you)

Within a day or two of the wedding, flowers are pressed to dry them flat and colour-true. We share a simple guide — no special equipment needed, just patience and a heavy book.

2. You courier, we check

Dried flowers travel well. On arrival we photograph everything and confirm which blooms cast best.

3. Design preview

You approve a layout — flower placement, any initials or date in gold, the shape (heart, frame or block).

4. Casting & curing

Flowers are set in thin layers of museum-grade clear resin over several days — slow pouring protects the petals and prevents bubbles.

5. Finishing & delivery

Edges are sanded, polished and gold-sealed, then the piece ships double-boxed.

How far ahead should you book?

3–4 weeks for the full process; in wedding season, 2 months. Explore memory pieces or enquire now.

BlogPost.title: Behind the Scenes: How a Custom Resin Piece Is Made
BlogPost.excerpt: From your first WhatsApp message to the polished piece at your door — every stage of a custom Artistic by Khushi commission.
BlogPost.content:
Custom orders, demystified

People assume custom = complicated. In truth, you do the fun part (the idea) and we do the patient part (the craft). Here's the full journey.

Stage 1 — The brief (Day 0)

You share the idea on WhatsApp or our inquiry form: what the piece is, who it's for, rough size, palette and date needed. Photos of the space or outfit help enormously.

Stage 2 — Design plan (Day 1–2)

We reply with a plan: dimensions, palette swatches, materials, timeline and an honest opinion on what will look best. You approve or tweak.

Stage 3 — Mockup (Day 3)

A layout preview shows text placement, colour flow and motifs. Nothing is poured until you say yes.

Stage 4 — Pouring (Day 4–6)

Layers are poured slowly — pigments, florals, gold — and left to cure bubble-free.

Stage 5 — Curing (Day 7–9)

Full hardness takes days; rushing it is how cheap resin cracks.

Stage 6 — Finishing (Day 10)

Edges sanded through four grits, polished, sealed, hardware fitted, care card packed.

Stage 7 — Dispatch

Double-boxed, tracked, shipped across India.

Ready?

Send your brief — we take limited custom slots monthly to keep quality high.

Page.title: About Us
Page.content:
Where memories become art

Artistic by Khushi is a small-batch resin art studio based in Surat, Gujarat, crafting personalized nameplates, home décor, jewellery and memory keepsakes — each piece poured, cured, sanded and polished by hand. We deliver across India and ship worldwide.

How it started

It began at a kitchen table with one silicone mould and a bridal bouquet a friend couldn't bear to throw away. That first preserved-flower heart — cloudy, imperfect, deeply loved — taught us what resin could really hold: not just flowers, but feeling.

What we believe

  • Personal beats perfect. Your names, colours and stories make art meaningful — we design around them.
  • Slow is a feature. Thin-poured layers, patient curing, four-grit polishing. Rushed resin cracks.
  • Honest craft. Real dried flowers, premium UV-stabilised resin, and timelines we actually keep.

How we work

Every order starts with a conversation — your idea, our design plan, a preview you approve before anything is poured. Nothing here is mass-produced, and that's exactly the point.

Let's make something together

Browse the collections, read the journal, or say hello — we reply personally.

When you submit an inquiry we collect your name, mobile number, city and optional message — only what you type into the form. We also record the page you enquired from and basic referral information.

How we use it

  • To respond to your inquiry on phone, WhatsApp or email
  • To maintain our lead records (stored in our database and a private Google Sheet)

What we never do

  • Sell or rent your information to anyone
  • Send unrelated marketing spam

Cookies & analytics

We may use standard, privacy-respecting analytics to count page views. No personal identity tracking.

Your choices

Ask us anytime to update or delete your inquiry data via our contact page.

Page.title: Terms & Conditions
Page.content:
Terms & Conditions

Last updated: 2025. By using this website and enquiring about our products you agree to these terms.

Custom-made products

All pieces are handcrafted to order. Design previews are approved before casting; after casting begins, design changes may not be possible.

Payments & pricing

Quoted prices are confirmed at order time. Custom orders typically require an advance before work begins.

Shipping

We ship across India with careful double-boxed packaging. Timelines are shared per order and depend on curing time.

Returns

Because each piece is personalized, returns aren't available for custom work. If a piece arrives damaged, contact us within 48 hours with photos — we repair or remake.

Handmade character

Tiny bubbles, micro-variations in floral placement and marble flow are the signature of handmade art, not defects.

Disclaimer

Last updated: 2025.

Handcrafted variance

Artistic by Khushi products are handmade. Product photographs are representative — each finished piece varies naturally in floral placement, marble flow and tone.

Care responsibility

Resin is durable but not indestructible. Follow the care card provided with each order; damage from heat, dropping or harsh chemicals is not covered.

Preserved florals

Flowers are natural materials and subtle tonal shifts over years are normal for organic inlays.

Third-party links

We are not responsible for content on external sites linked from our pages.

Faq.question: Can the nameplate survive outdoor weather?
Faq.answer: Yes — we use UV-stabilised resin and seal the backing. For fully exposed entrances we recommend a shaded placement for the longest life.

Faq.question: How do I send my family name and font choice?
Faq.answer: After enquiring, we'll share a short design form plus a preview mockup before pouring. Nothing is made until you approve the design.

Faq.question: Can I get a different mantra?
Faq.answer: Yes — any mantra, shloka or Sanskrit verse can be calligraphed. Share the text at enquiry and we'll confirm the layout in your design preview.

Faq.question: Can I order matching sets for return gifts?
Faq.answer: Yes — sets of 10+ carry a special rate and coordinated packaging. Share your event date at enquiry.

Faq.question: How do I send my bouquet flowers?
Faq.answer: After enquiring, we share a simple pressing & packaging guide. Couriers across India are fine — flowers travel well when dried correctly.

Faq.question: How far in advance should I book?
Faq.answer: Memory slots need 3–4 weeks (drying + curing). For wedding-season orders, book 2 months ahead.

Faq.question: Do you deliver across India and worldwide?
Faq.answer: Yes! We deliver pan-India (careful double-boxed packaging, tracked shipping) AND ship internationally to most countries. International shipping cost and timeline are confirmed at order time.

Faq.question: Do you take custom orders?
Faq.answer: Yes — custom is our happy place! Share your idea (size, colours, theme, text) via the inquiry form or WhatsApp and we'll send a design plan and quote.

Faq.question: How long does an order take?
Faq.answer: Most pieces ship in 7–10 days after design approval. Memory preservation pieces take 3–4 weeks (drying + curing). Festive-season bulk orders: book 2 months ahead.

Faq.question: How do I place an order?
Faq.answer: There's no cart — just enquire! Fill the inquiry form on any product page or message us on WhatsApp. We confirm the design, quote and timeline personally.

Faq.question: How do I pay?
Faq.answer: After design approval, we share payment details (UPI / bank transfer). Custom orders need a small advance; balance before dispatch.

Faq.question: Can I get my wedding bouquet preserved?
Faq.answer: Absolutely — it's our most-loved service. We guide you through pressing and couriering the flowers, then design the keepsake with you.

Faq.question: Are the flowers real?
Faq.answer: Yes — real dried flowers, preserved and sealed in premium resin. No fakes, ever.

Faq.question: Will the resin turn yellow?
Faq.answer: We use UV-stabilised, non-yellowing resin. Kept out of harsh direct sunlight, your piece stays crystal-clear for years.

HomepageSection.heading: Where Memories Become Art
HomepageSection.subheading: A small-batch resin art studio from Surat, crafting one-of-a-kind pieces since 2021
HomepageSection.body:
Artistic by Khushi began at a kitchen table — with one mould, a bundle of wedding flowers and a wish to make beautiful things that hold meaning. Today, every nameplate, tray, frame and keepsake that leaves our studio is still made the same way: slowly, carefully, and completely by hand.

We don't mass-produce. We design each piece around your names, colours, flowers and stories, then pour, cure, sand and polish it over several days so it arrives ready to be treasured for years.
